title: How to add page numbers with PDF Fix Hub
excerpt: Choose one of four positions, add current / total page numbers and avoid duplicate overlays when revising a PDF.
author: The MY PDF FIX Team
body:
## Know the format before you begin

[Add Page Numbers](/add-page-numbers-to-pdf) writes numbers onto every page in the format `current / total`. A three-page PDF receives `1 / 3`, `2 / 3` and `3 / 3`. The available positions are **Bottom center**, **Bottom right**, **Bottom left** and **Top center**. You can set the font size.

The interface does not provide Roman numerals, custom text such as “Page 1 of 3,” a custom starting number, alternating margins or a color picker. It uses a standard Helvetica font. If your submission requires another numbering system, this tool may not fit that requirement.

## Example: number a three-page report

1. Keep an unnumbered copy of the report.
2. Open [Add Page Numbers](/add-page-numbers-to-pdf) and choose that copy.
3. Choose **Bottom center** and start with a font size of 12.
4. Click **Process**, then **Download**.
5. Open the saved PDF and inspect all three pages. Check that the numbers read `1 / 3` through `3 / 3`, are visible and do not overlap a signature, footer or diagram.

This is an example of the expected format, not a test result for your document. Review landscape and already-rotated pages separately; a position that works on one page may overlap content on another.

## Make room and finalize the page order first

If there is no clear space at the edge, [Add Margin](/add-margin-to-pdf) can enlarge the page around its content before numbering. It does not shrink the existing content or force the output onto A4 or Letter. Check the resulting page size and print settings.

Combine sections with [Merge PDF](/merge-pdf), remove unwanted pages and finish any [reordering](/reorder-pdf-pages) before adding numbers. Otherwise the printed numbers may disagree with the final page positions.

## Keep a cover unnumbered using separate files

There is no “skip cover” switch. For a four-page document with an unnumbered cover, use [Extract Pages](/extract-pdf-pages) twice: once with `1` for the cover and once with `2-4` for the body. Number only the three-page body, then merge the original cover first and the numbered body second.

The body will display `1 / 3` to `3 / 3`, not `2 / 4` to `4 / 4`. If you need the latter convention, the current controls cannot produce it automatically.

## Revise from the unnumbered original

Numbers are drawn as page content. Running the tool on an already-numbered copy adds another set; it does not find and replace the previous numbers. If you change the page order or insert a page, return to your unnumbered master and generate a new numbered copy. Keep signed originals separately, because rewriting them can invalidate digital signatures.
